about: LFM2.5-8B-A1B (LiquidAI's Q4_K_M GGUF, 5.16 GB) on an RTX A2000 8GB Laptop GPU (35 W): llama.cpp b11681, the whole model and its full 128,000-token context on the GPU, f16 KV (only 6 of 24 layers hold KV), ubatch 1024, Liquid AI's sampling (temp 0.1, top-k 50, repeat penalty 1.05). Measured on a ThinkPad P1 Gen 5 (i7-12700H, 32 GB single-channel DDR5, display on the Intel GPU), 30 s decode runs: 102.6 tok/s and 2,379 tok/s prefill with f16 KV on a 16K prompt, 101.3 with q8_0, 100.7 with q4_0, 101.1 with ubatch 1024; over a 90K-token prompt the engine log shows 2,108 tok/s prefill. Tool calls: at temperature 0.6 the model made a parsed call in 26 of 30 lab-style requests, and each of those used the result on the next turn. The other 4 wrote the call as plain <tool_call> JSON in the content, so about one tools request in eight needs a retry. Long prompts are unreliable too: asked for a code planted at the end of a 90K-token prompt, it gave the code in 13 of 20 answers; the others said it had too little information or gave a wrong number. Earlier lab runs of this launch failed once on the tools check and once on the context check.
